_Description: Fallback protocol (see opts.protocol.fallback): multi-parameter mapping (MPM, Weiskopf 2013) of all vendors and field strengths, i.e. the echoes of the 3D multi-echo spoiled gradient echo with PD, T1, and MT weighting (flip angles 4-25 degree, TR 15-40 ms), also the later echoes that do not fit the T1w fallback
